text:
incidents-bot: [REGION ALERT] eu1 serving pool: kernel queue slope detected on a subset of nodes running gpt-large families. Observed p99 tail latency spikes (5-20s) for large-context generation. Affected: hosted generation endpoints using 'gpt-large-v2' / 'gptx-2b'. Status: https://status.redwood.example/incident/2248800123. Triage channel: #eng-runtime.
Maya (oncall): I'm on it — checking node metrics and kernel alloc logs now. Initial signs point to allocator/backpressure rather than a networking blip.
Samir: Starting rollback of the 2024-11-07 kernel build on eu1 canaries. Rolling to previous tag across 20% first batch. ETA ~8m.
Liam: FYI seeing KV cache eviction spike around same time window — likely memory pressure amplifying queues.
Maya (oncall): Canary traffic switched to reverted kernel on 3 nodes. p99 improved from ~12s -> ~2.4s on those canaries. Pushing wider if stable.
June: CS heads up — preparing customer notification for impacted tenants. Draft template: https://docs.redwood.example/cs/incident-templates#eu1-kernel-slope
Maya (oncall): Mitigation plan executed: 1) rollback kernel build on canaries 2) route heavy-context traffic to fallback model 'gpt-medium-v1' for critical customers 3) increase autoscaler target for eu1 by +10%.
Ops (infra): Autoscaler change applied, new target is in effect. Monitoring for scaling events.
Samir: Root-cause hypothesis: regression in slab allocator path causing slower reclaim under long-sequence workloads. Will open PR to revert the specific patch and add an integration test for long-context memory patterns.
Maya (oncall): Current status: partial mitigation in place, customer impact significantly reduced but some tenants still see degraded tails. Fallback routing active for highest-impact customers. Running full rollback across eu1 next if canaries stay healthy. Next update in 10m.
Liam: Quick troubleshooting command if you need to force a graceful worker restart on a node: ```for n in eu1-pool-*; ssh $n 'sudo systemctl restart redwood-inference'``` — only run with oncall coordination.
Ops (infra): No data-plane 5xx spike observed, mostly elevated latency. No SLA breach detected so far.
Samir: Created INF-6421 to track revert PR, tests, and postmortem. Assigned to eng-runtime sprint.
Maya (oncall): Action items: Samir (revert PR + tests), Ops (complete rollback rollout and monitor), CS (customer comms), Maya (final status and postmortem kickoff). Please ping me directly for any urgent escalations.
June: Sending initial customer notices now to impacted list.
Maya (oncall): Final note for now: if you see kernel_queue > 80% or p99 > 5s in eu1, ping @Maya and @Samir. Will post final summary + RCA link once the revert lands. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
